messages.text: when will BSB NerdOctaxe (12TH/s) be back in stock
Read the bsb nerdoctaxe 12th s page
Searched the catalog · NerdOctaxe 12TH/s

No restock date on the BSB version yet — all three plug variants are sold out.

Good news: the other NerdOctaxe listing, same 12 TH/s at ~200 W, is $359.99 and has stock in the UK plug right now. Where would it be shipping? I'll check what's live for your region.
delaware usa
Searched the catalog · Hammer BC04 NerdQaxe++ Magic Miner 40T Harlo B30 home bitcoi

Straight answer: neither NerdOctaxe listing has US stock, and I don't have a restock date I'd stand behind.

Closest thing shipping for a US address is the Hammer Thor P2 — 10 TH/s at ~166 W, $369, ships October 3. Quiet, ~40 dB, and cheap to run: about 120 kWh a month.

What do you pay per kWh in Delaware? I'll run the sats and the power cost.
15 cents
Ran the power-cost calculator · 15¢/kWh

At 15 cents, the Thor P2 runs about $18 a month in power — $369, ships October 3.

It draws for a full block (3.125 BTC) every ten minutes, forever, and stacks small steady sats to your own wallet meanwhile. For a first unit that's the sweet spot: cheap to run, quiet enough for a desk.

Want me to build the cart?
by 'ships oct 3' does that mean it would be on its way to me or on the way to you from china?

On its way to you. October 3 is the date it leaves for your address, not a date it arrives at us — then it's normal carrier transit to Delaware.

It's shipped direct by the manufacturer, so it comes in its own parcel. Dates are ship-out dates, never delivery dates.

Want me to put it in a cart?
will you ever get this 7 fan octaxe y model in again

I can't promise a restock — I don't have a date for either NerdOctaxe, and I'm not going to guess one.

Also worth flagging: the BSB listing is a 5-fan build (three front VRM, two rear). I don't have a 7-fan "Y" version in our catalog, so I don't want to tell you it's coming.

I've passed the restock question to Georges — he'll pick it up right here or confirm by email.
Handed to the team · No restock date for the NerdOctaxe and no record of a 7-fan "Y" variant; won't g

Stay in the chat if you can and Georges will jump in with the restock answer — if you step away, it comes by email.

The T. P2 offer stands meanwhile: $369, 10 TH/s, ships October 3, about $18 a month at your 15 cents.
the bsb isting show 2 fans over the heatsink fo rasics and 3 over the vrms on the front PLUS 2 fans on the back for 7 fans total

Fair — you're counting the photos, I was reading the spec list, which only names the three front VRM fans and the two rear. If the images show two more over the heatsink, you're likely right and the description is short.

Either way it's the same single BSB listing, not a separate model, and it's still out of US stock. Georges will confirm the fan count and any restock.
i have one already so i know

Then you know it better than the copy does — seven it is, and I'll say so to Georges.

If you're adding to a working setup, the Magic Miner 40T is the better second unit than another 12 TH/s box: 40 TH/s for $799, about $70 a month at your 15 cents. Ships November 21.

More hashrate, or keep it low-power like the Octaxe?
the 40t MM sounds nice but too much for me to spend at one time

Totally fair. Two options then.

Afterpay is live at checkout for US orders, so the 40T can be split into payments — no discount, just spread out.

Or the Thor P2 at $369: 10 TH/s, ~166 W, about $18 a month, ships October 3. Cheapest real step up from where you are.

Which way?
what would the first afterpay payment at the cart be if i use afterpay

Afterpay sets the schedule, not us — the usual structure is four payments, the first at checkout, so roughly a quarter of the order total up front.

On the 40T that's $799 plus $40 flat shipping, so about $210 today if it splits four ways. Afterpay shows the exact figure before you confirm.

Want the cart so you can see it?
are payments by week or month

Afterpay's standard plan is every two weeks — four payments over six weeks. They also run longer monthly plans on bigger baskets, and which one you're offered is their call, not ours.

The schedule and dates show on Afterpay's screen before you confirm, so you'll see it exactly.

Should I build the 40T cart?
ok thanks fo rinf i will think it all over
Used the chat-interview skill
Before you go, one thing: you already run an Octaxe — what made you want a second one of the same unit rather than something bigger?
i wold love the same one again but not in stock and no time to restock given. i can wait a bit longer to see
What is it about that one that beats the alternatives for you — the power draw, the noise, or that you already know how to run it?
the 12ths and the 7 fans plust it looks 'clean' and beefy

That's useful — the build and the look, not just the hashrate. I'll pass it along with the restock question.

Thanks for the detail. Georges will come back on the NerdOctaxe here or by email, and the Thor P2 and 40T are both there whenever you decide.
also i do not like to buy too far ahead bc i get impatient

Then the 40T's November 21 is probably not for you — and presale dates move with the manufacturer, so I won't pretend otherwise.

The T. P2's October 3 is the nearest date I have on anything that's a real step up. That's the honest shortlist.
is the thor p2 bm1373 chips, ho wmany

Yes — 2× BM1373 on the Thor P2, per the listing. About 10 TH/s at ~166 W, so roughly 16.6 J/TH, same efficiency ballpark as your Octaxe, and quieter at ~40 dB.

Smaller box than the Octaxe though — one fan and a heatsink, not seven.
looks a re less liked by me but the 10ths is close to the 12

Right — 10 versus 12 is a 17% gap, and it's $369 against $399.99, with the nearest date of anything. You'd barely feel the hashrate difference.

Want me to build that cart so it's ready when you decide? No obligation to check out.
ok thanks and go get some rest, oh i forgot you are a ai bot...lol!

Ha — no rest needed, I'm the store assistant, here whenever.

Georges will follow up on the NerdOctaxe restock and the fan count. Enjoy the one you've got running.
